item.title: 5FM x Dial Direct: Spin the Wheel - share of R50,000 cash – 5FM / Dial Direct
item.description: Prize: Spin the wheel live on 5 Drive and win the cash amount it lands on, share of R50,000 across the week (doubled if you opt in for a Dial Direct quote). Deadline: October 30, 2026. Enter via the form on the 5FM competition page; selected entrants are called live on 5 Drive. Free; the Dial Direct quote opt-in is optional. Closes 30 October 2026. Residency requirements: see 5FM Ts&Cs (South Africa assumed)

item.title: 947 x Takealot Black November: Win a R5,000 Takealot voucher – Primedia / Takealot
item.description: Prize: R5,000 Takealot voucher per day if you guess the mystery product correctly on 947 (Johannesburg) (R6,000 for TakealotMORE subscribers), daily 26-30 October. Deadline: October 30, 2026. Needs your South African ID number: listen for the mystery product trailer (weekdays 15:00-18:00), then WhatsApp the keyword Takealot with your name and ID number to 061 4 947 947. One entry is picked each day and called live with Thando on 947 Drive; you win only if you guess the product. Free apart from data, no purchase. 18+ is not stated; no win on Primedia stations in the last 90 days. Runs 23-30 October 2026

item.title: Algoa FM x MTN (Eastern Cape only): Win up to R6,000 cash or MTN home internet – Algoa FM / MTN
item.description: Prize: R4,000 cash weekly via MTN MoMo (+R2,000 for MTN recharge of R50+), grand prize MTN Unlimited Home Internet for 12 months (R20,000). Deadline: October 30, 2026. Telegram or WhatsApp the word MTN plus your name, surname, town and story to 061 794 0940 (data rates apply) or use the form on the competition page; no purchase needed for the base prize. Only for people living in the Algoa FM broadcast area (Eastern Cape), 18+, winners must be South African citizens. Closes 30 October 2026

item.title: Jago Grahak Jago Quiz 2026 – MyGov / Department of Consumer Affairs
